answer: The defence rests on messaging account age with registration timestamp: an account registered years ago and used ever since. Forging 549 of these means building 549 separate aged accounts from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The thread check runs in the open: 549 fakes pay the full price 549 times, one honest agent pays once, and the timber trail in the ledger makes the reef cost visible to everyone.
